0.0: I hate to be the bearer of bad news, but I can sense the presence of a terrible, uncool force: Poseur Musicians! They're hiding all over Maple World, creating dissonance with their over-inflated sense of musical prowess. Would you kindly take them down a few pegs for me?

yes.0: They may be hiding at first, but as you stay in one area hunting monsters near your level, I can bet they'll come out to accost you with their newest terrible mixtape or something.

no.0: Do-Mi-So~ Mi-Fa-So~ So-Re-So~\r\nYeah, there's nothing that kills a good groove like the kind of dissonance those Poseur Musicians like to pass off as music.

1.0: Do-Mi-So~ Mi-Fa-So~ So-Fa-Ra~\r\nI knew you had it in you! The dissonance stopped as soon as you'd taken care of those Poseur Musicians!

yes.0: Here! #b#i4036552# #t4036552##k is finally complete. Take it!

default.0: Poseur Musicians will appear as you're hunting monsters near your level in one area. They may seem reserved at first, but if you give 'em even a little attention, they won't leave you be.
